anomalies.observed: In the EPD_Driver sheet, capacitor C2 is specified as 4.7uF/25V and is connected between the charge-pump node Net-(U11-K) and the boost switch node Net-(Q3-D).
anomalies.expected: The specification describes the EPD driver as a near-exact implementation of the PDI reference, with the relevant EPD capacitors specified as 1 uF values (1 uF/6.3 V for the G1-specific cap and 1 uF/25 V for the default caps). No 4.7 uF EPD-driver capacitor is listed.

anomalies.impact: Replacing the specified 1 uF charge-pump/EPD-driver capacitor with 4.7 uF changes the charge-pump time constants and can alter the e-paper boost/charge-pump behavior, affecting display voltage generation or refresh timing.

parsed.summary: Most connectivity matches the specification, but the EPD driver contains a 4.7 uF/25 V capacitor C2 where the referenced PDI circuit uses 1 uF EPD capacitors, which is a value deviation that can affect display power generation.
